products.name: ROG Strix Scar 16 (2025) — RTX 5080, 240Hz OLED
products.description: Flagship 16-inch gaming laptop with RTX 5080 graphics and a 240Hz OLED panel.

look.summary: An off-black 16-inch slab of a laptop, 35.4 cm wide and between 2.28 and 3.08 cm thick. The full keyboard, with a number pad, lights up key by key in RGB, joined by an Aura Sync logo, a light bar and an AniMe Vision display.

details: USB-C, 3 × USB-A, HDMI 2.1, Ethernet, headphone/mic combo

Light spills from two sides of the chassis and three sides of the plush leatherette wrist rest, which attaches magnetically.
